intent: I came within inches of opening the door when I saw Dad. His hand moved toward the loose seal beneath the workshop window—the same defect he complained about for years—and that tiny familiar gesture nearly erased every survival rule I have left. I ask Mike to watch the direction Dad went and tell me whether he is alone. I do not admit that I have already decided to search at first light if Dad does not return.
emotion: urgent, shaken, practical, and barely restraining reckless hope
